milestones.title: Shared cache plan improves real-session payload stability across providers
milestones.goal: A provider-neutral cache plan is implemented and consumed by openai-completions, openai-responses, and anthropic, with replay-based evidence from real sessions showing stronger stable-prefix preservation and provider-specific payload correctness.

verification.command: npm test -- prompt-cache-policy cache-plan openai-completions openai-responses anthropic
verification.expect: Targeted prompt-cache and provider-projection tests pass.

verification.command: Run a /tmp replay script over one or more real session files from ~/.mu/sessions, project adjacent turns into openai-completions payloads via imported modules, and assert stable-prefix metrics are captured and regressions are explained.
verification.expect: Replay output for openai-completions includes stable-prefix hashes, tool-layer hashes, and adjacent-turn diff metrics.

verification.command: Run a /tmp replay script over one or more real session files from ~/.mu/sessions, project adjacent turns into openai-responses payloads via imported modules, and assert stable-prefix metrics are captured and regressions are explained.
verification.expect: Replay output for openai-responses includes stable-prefix hashes, tool-layer hashes, and adjacent-turn diff metrics.

verification.command: Run a /tmp replay script over one or more real session files from ~/.mu/sessions, project adjacent turns into anthropic payloads via imported modules, and assert stable-prefix metrics plus cache_control placement are captured and explained.
verification.expect: Replay output for anthropic includes stable-prefix hashes, adjacent-turn diff metrics, and cache_control placement evidence consistent with the shared cache plan.

verification.command: Review the cache-plan abstraction and all three provider projections against SPEC.md and ARCHITECTURE.md, with emphasis on shared semantics, deterministic ordering, and additive Anthropic-specific optimization. Write findings JSON.
verification.expect: Review finds the milestone correct or reports actionable blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Use a real non-interactive `mu --mode json` or equivalent provider request path plus `curl` or captured request logging to verify that provider-bound payloads emitted from a replayed real session reflect the shared cache-plan layer ordering on the actual request surface.
verification.expect: A real request-surface check shows the projected payload structure reaching the provider/client boundary in the intended layer order.

milestones.notes: The milestone closes only when the shared abstraction is implemented, the three primary providers consume it, and replay evidence from real sessions demonstrates the intended behavior.
